description: Reads one escrow job from Base Mainnet and AgentSLA's records: status (active, settled or reclaimed), creator, provider, listing and endpoint, price, fee, registered latency limit, created time, and when the creator may reclaim it if the oracle has not settled it. Use it after register_escrow_terms to follow a job to completion. Free and read-only.

jobId.description: Escrow job id, returned by register_escrow_terms, e.g. 2.

name: get_escrow_job
title: Get an escrow job's status
